item.title: The mayor of Scamtown
item.description: "Join the Mayor of Scamtown podcast as we delve into the wild world of scams, cons, and swindles. Exploring the latest trends and tactics used by scammers, we'll keep you informed and ahead of the game. Tune in for entertaining and educational episodes that will leave you scam-savvy and ready to take on the scammers."
